records.translation: 染色通道以染料命名（``CorrDNA``、``CorrER``、``CorrMito``、``CorrPhalloidin``、``CorrWGA``）；测序通道对每个循环和碱基为 ``Cycle<CC>_<base>``，另加 ``Cycle01_DAPI``。同一站点的染色裁剪图和测序裁剪图共用一个像素网格，并且已经过照明校正和对齐，因此本读取器按原样堆叠：不拼接、不做循环配准、不重新缩放。

records.context: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a microplate sample position can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path adds ``"ph_flatfield"``, ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"ph_masks"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, run only when named here and after those four; ``ph_flatfield`` builds the laboratory microplate's maps once, before the microplate sample positions, and ``ph_masks`` writes each cell's microscope field of view-edge flags and flat-microscope field of view gains from the saved masks. A processing session of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its microplate sample positions from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each microplate sample position's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the microplate sample positions run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``. ``"ph_merged"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``merge``) writes each microscope field of view to ``merged/`` (:func:`_ph_merged`); ``"ph_tables"`` (after ``aggregate``) writes the standard ``measurements/measurements.db`` tables (:func:`_ph_tables`); ``"ph_crops"`` cuts raw extracted image regions of owned cells into a sharded store (:func:`_ph_crops`). ``"ph_ownership"`` (per microplate sample position, after ``ph_masks``) finds the copies of each cell across overlapping microscope fields of view (:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`). ``"report"``, last, writes the yield funnel and the counts against a published table to ``results/ops_report/`` (:func:`_ph_report`). With ``ops_ph_secondary_registration`` set, each microplate sample position's second phenotype acquisition is registered before its microscope fields of view are read (:func:`_ph_secondary_shifts`). The alpha ``decode_qc`` phase (items 876 and 877) fits the false-call model and the genotype confidence over the microplate sample positions decoded, writing ``results/ops_decode_qc``; it also executes after ``decode`` when ``ops_decode_qc`` or ``ops_genotype_confidence`` is on. The alpha ``compare_calls`` phase (item 878) matches spaCR's calls to other workflows' per-cell tables (``ops_compare_tables``) and writes ``results/ops_compare``; it also executes after ``decode`` when those tables are set. With ``ops_compare_match`` ``"mask_overlap"`` (item 922) it executes alone and matches spaCR's label masks to a reference workflow's by pixel overlap instead (:func:`spacr.ops_decode.run_compare_masks`). The alpha profile path, ``"profile"`` and ``"evaluate"``, runs alone: it turns the stored cell tables of ``ops_profile_cells`` into gene profiles and scores them against reference gene pairs (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`); ``"modules"`` builds the module atlas of those profiles (:func:`spacr.ops_modules.run_module_phase`) and ``"mitocarta"`` scores clusterings against MitoCarta and an external module table (:func:`spacr.ops_clusters.run_mitocarta_benchmark`); like the profile path, both hold the BLAS and OpenMP pools to one thread while ``ops_deterministic_blas`` is on (the result's ``atlas_blas_threads``). ``"stress"``, after ``report``, times the finished store and writes ``results/ops_stress/stress_test.csv`` (:func:`spacr.ops_run_infra.stress_rows`); ``ops_stress_report`` runs it too.

``"ph_flatfield"``、``"ph_segment"``、``"ph_measure"``、``"ph_masks"``、``"merge"`` 和 ``"aggregate"``，仅在此处列出时运行，且在前述四个阶段之后；``ph_flatfield`` 在处理各孔之前为该板一次性构建图，``ph_masks`` 根据保存的掩膜写出每个细胞的视野边缘标记和平场增益。仅运行这些阶段时需要 ``dst_root`` 和 ``plate``，但不需要 ``genotype_source``，孔取自 ``ops_phenotype``，并在每个孔的 ``ops_report.json`` 中追加内容而不是替换它。``aggregate`` 汇总已运行的孔，写出 ``ops_guides_<plate>`` 和 表（:func:`_ph_tables`）；``"ph_crops"`` 将所属细胞的原始裁剪图切出并存入分片存储（:func:`_ph_crops`）。``"ph_ownership"``（逐孔，在 ``ph_masks`` 之后）在重叠视野之间查找每个细胞的副本（:func:`_ph_cross_field_ownership`）。``"report"`` 877）在已解码的孔上拟合错误判定模型和基因型置信度，写出 ``results/ops_decode_qc``；它也会在 ``decode`` 之后运行，条件是开启了 ``ops_decode_qc`` 或 ``ops_genotype_confidence``。Alpha ``compare_calls`` 阶段（条目 878）将 spaCR 的判定与其他流程的逐细胞表（``ops_compare_tables``）匹配，并写出 ``results/ops_compare``；设置这些表时，它也会在 ``decode`` 之后运行。当 ``ops_compare_match`` 为 ``"mask_overlap"``（条目 922）时，它单独运行，改为按像素重叠将 spaCR 的标签掩膜与参考流程的掩膜匹配（:func:`spacr.ops_decode.run_compare_masks`）。Alpha 谱路径 ``"profile"`` 和 ``"evaluate"`` 单独运行：它将 ``ops_profile_cells`` 中存储的细胞表转换为基因谱，并针对参考基因对评分（:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`）；``"modules"`` 构建这些谱的模块图谱（:func:`spacr.ops_modules.run_module_phase`），``"mitocarta"`` 针对 MitoCarta 之后对完成的存储计时，并写出 ``results/ops_stress/stress_test.csv``（:func:`spacr.ops_run_infra.stress_rows`）；``ops_stress_report`` 也会运行它。

The profile path's alpha ``"cluster_sweep"`` (item 916, the Leiden resolution sweep) and ``"etest"`` (item 917, the per-gene E-test and its statistical detection sensitivity curve) phases run inside :func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`. Like the profile path, the flat-microscope field of view and score phases hold the BLAS and OpenMP pools to one thread while ``ops_deterministic_blas`` is on (the result's ``blas_threads``). With ``ops_layout`` set to ``'cpg_cropped'`` (alpha, items 919 and 920) only ``"cpg_index"``, ``"cpg_merged"`` and ``"prefix_decode"`` run (:func:`spacr.cpg_cropped.run_cpg_phases`, :func:`spacr.ops_prefix.run_prefix_decode`); the default phases mean the first two, and the decode too under ``ops_library_mode='spacer_prefix'``.

One site is about 300 MB raw and more than 1 GB once Cellpose holds float32 copies, flows and probabilities, so the OPS phenotype path, sized for 2,960 px fields, cannot segment it in one piece on a worker with a fixed RAM budget. records.translation: PERISCOPE 将其染色图像以每孔 100 张裁剪图的形式发布，每张 5,500 x 5,500 px x 5 个通道，uint16。一个站点原始数据约 300 MB，Cellpose 保存 float32 副本、流场和概率后超过 1 GB，因此按 2,960 px 视野设计的 OPS 表型路径无法在 RAM 预算固定的工作进程上一次性分割它。本模块增加了：

records.translation: ``'keep'`` 保留所有对象。``'exclude'`` 丢弃接触裁剪图边界的所有对象。``'own'`` 处理与已放置的相邻裁剪图之间被接缝切开的对象（``neighbours`` 将一条边映射到相邻裁剪图的标签，相邻裁剪图无重叠地紧贴）：本裁剪图中的碎片与相邻裁剪图中跨接缝与之相接的碎片属于同一细胞，由包含较大部分的裁剪图保留；并列时由上方或左侧的裁剪图保留，因此两张裁剪图绝不会同时保留或同时丢弃同一个细胞。位于没有已知相邻裁剪图一侧的对象被丢弃，与 ``'exclude'`` 相同。

records.context: Extracted image region-seq style optical screening experiments (Feldman et al. 2019; PERISCOPE, Ramezani et al. 2025) sequence the guide's own spacer, not a separate barcode. The library table (``Barcodes.csv``, column ``sgRNA``) is the whitelist, and only the first N bases are read: CellProfiler's ``CallBarcodes`` used 10 cycles for A549 and 12 for HeLa although 12 were imaged. Spacers of different guides can share a short prefix, so the whitelist is the set of UNIQUE prefixes, and prefixes shared by guides of different genes are reported and never called.
records.label: spacr.ops_prefix#1
records.source: CROP-seq style optical screens (Feldman et al. 2019; PERISCOPE, Ramezani et al. 2025) sequence the guide's own spacer, not a separate barcode. The library table (``Barcodes.csv``, column ``sgRNA``) is the whitelist, and only the first N bases are read: CellProfiler's ``CallBarcodes`` used 10 cycles for A549 and 12 for HeLa although 12 were imaged. Spacers of different guides can share a short prefix, so the whitelist is the set of UNIQUE prefixes, and prefixes shared by guides of different genes are reported and never called.
records.translation: CROP-seq 式光学筛选（Feldman et al. 2019；PERISCOPE，Ramezani et al. 2025）测序的是向导自身的间隔序列，而不是单独的条形码。文库表（``Barcodes.csv``，``sgRNA`` 列）即白名单，且只读取前 N 个碱基：虽然成像了 12 个循环，CellProfiler 的 ``CallBarcodes`` 对 A549 使用 10 个循环，对 HeLa 使用 12 个。不同向导的间隔序列可能共享较短的前缀，因此白名单是唯一前缀的集合，不同基因的向导共享的前缀会被报告且从不判定。

records.context: A read is first cut to the key's cycles (:attr:`PrefixLibrary.positions`; reads given as keys with ``keyed=True`` are taken as they are). An exact match is ``exact``. Otherwise the keys within ``max_distance`` are found: one closest key is ``corrected``, two or more equally close keys are ``ambiguous``, none is ``out_of_library``. Under ``'hamming'`` a distance is the number of differing cycles; under ``'levenshtein'`` a single skipped or extra base also counts as one, matched against the spacer's next base. An ``N`` (a cycle that was not measured) matches any base and costs nothing; reads with one are matched by Hamming distance. A unique match to a key that cannot be called (a prefix collision) is ``collision``.
records.label: spacr.ops_prefix.match_prefix_reads#1
records.source: A read is first cut to the key's cycles (:attr:`PrefixLibrary.positions`; reads given as keys with ``keyed=True`` are taken as they are). An exact match is ``exact``. Otherwise the keys within ``max_distance`` are found: one closest key is ``corrected``, two or more equally close keys are ``ambiguous``, none is ``out_of_library``. Under ``'hamming'`` a distance is the number of differing cycles; under ``'levenshtein'`` a single skipped or extra base also counts as one, matched against the spacer's next base. An ``N`` (a cycle that was not measured) matches any base and costs nothing; reads with one are matched by Hamming distance. A unique match to a key that cannot be called (a prefix collision) is ``collision``.
records.translation: 读数先截取到键的循环（:attr:`PrefixLibrary.positions`；以键形式给出且 ``keyed=True`` 的读数按原样使用）。精确匹配为 ``exact``。否则查找 ``max_distance`` 以内的键：唯一最近的键为 ``corrected``，两个或更多同样近的键为 ``ambiguous``，没有则为 ``out_of_library``。在 ``'hamming'`` 下，距离为不同循环的数目；在 ``'levenshtein'`` 下，单个缺失或多余的碱基也计为 1，并与间隔序列的下一个碱基比对。``N``（未测量的循环）与任何碱基匹配且不计代价；含此类循环的读数按 Hamming 距离匹配。唯一匹配到不可判定的键（前缀冲突）时为 ``collision``。
